3.t: by His creation of male and female!

4.t: The ways you take differ greatly.

5.t: There is the one who gives, who is mindful of God,

7.t: We shall smooth his way towards ease.

8.t: There is the one who is miserly, who is self-satisfied,

10.t: We shall smooth his way towards hardship

11.t: and his wealth will not help him as he falls.

12.t: Our part is to provide guidance––

13.t: this world and the next belong to Us––

14.t: so I warn you about the raging Fire,

15.t: in which none but the most wicked one will burn,

16.t: who denied [the truth], and turned away.

17.t: The most pious one will be spared this––

18.t: who gives his wealth away as self-purification,

19.t: not to return a favour to anyone

20.t: but for the sake of his Lord the Most High––

21.t: and he will be well pleased.
